# Garmy

Garmy is an Obsidian plugin (id garmidian) that builds a dashboard from your
own Garmin data inside a note. You paste a Garmin Personal API key, Garmy loads
up to a year of history into one note per day, and a four-step wizard (key,
load, choose, preview) picks sports and metrics and writes Dashy blocks
(stats, dashy-chart, heatmap, progress, countdown) into a note. The note is
plain markdown. Garmy needs the Dashy plugin to draw the blocks.

The key stays in Obsidian's secure storage and requests go only to
personal.connectapi.garmin.com. There is no telemetry. Garmy leaves out
Training Readiness and VO2 max (Garmin's Personal API does not provide them)
and does not write distance_km. It has not been tested on a phone yet.
Garmy is not affiliated with Garmin. Data source: Garmin.

Site: https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/
Repository: https://github.com/Dimagious/garmidian
Community plugin listing: https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/garmidian
Plugin id: garmidian

## Guides

Step-by-step pages, one question each, with the YAML Garmy writes:

- All guides: https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/
- Garmin sleep and HRV dashboard in Obsidian (six recovery cards, 7 day
  averages against your usual, two line charts):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-sleep-hrv-dashboard/
- Garmin Personal API key (where it lives in Garmin Connect, what Garmy reads
  with it, what it cannot do):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-personal-api-key/
- Garmin Connect to Obsidian without Health Sync (what Garmy does, and
  existing-notes mode for notes Health Sync already wrote):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-to-obsidian-without-health-sync/
- A triathlon training log in Obsidian (run, bike, swim and strength cards,
  weekly bars, year map, monthly goals, race countdown):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/obsidian-triathlon-training-log/
- A weekly training heatmap in Obsidian (year by sport, month calendar, weekly
  bars from run_min, bike_min, swim_min and strength_min):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/weekly-training-heatmap-obsidian/
- Eleven Garmin dashboards for Obsidian (the wizard's library: glance, sleep,
  recovery, steps, one page per sport, triathlon, race build, weekly and
  monthly review, year):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-dashboard-templates-obsidian/
- A running dashboard in Obsidian from Garmin (weekly distance, sessions,
  monthly goal, miles):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-running-dashboard-obsidian/
- A weekly and monthly review in Obsidian with Garmin data (period: note):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/obsidian-weekly-review-garmin/
- A race countdown and build-up in Obsidian from Garmin:
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-race-countdown-obsidian/
- A steps dashboard in Obsidian (streaks, monthly goal, year map):
  https://dimagious.github.io/garmidian/guides/garmin-steps-streak-obsidian/
